versions.changelog:
- Added a "Start on APIDot" section to highlight main entry points for Wan 2.6 users, especially for ClawHub integration.
- Removed the "skill-card.md" file.
- No changes to core functionality; documentation and links updated for improved onboarding and clarity.

Initial release providing APIDot Wan 2.6 API documentation guidance and best practices.

- Includes SKILL.md with a detailed overview of Wan 2.6 API usage, integration planning, async workflow, and model routing.
- Documentation-focused: no executable scripts, network requests, or credential storage included.
- Emphasizes secure handling of API keys and points users to official APIDot resources for up-to-date request fields and examples.
- Supports common text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-shot, and webhook-based workflows for Wan 2.6 via APIDot.
- Lists official APIDot links and support channels for further help.
